title: The a-function for gauge theories
claim: Constructs the a-function at four-loop order for a general gauge theory with fermions and scalars using only one- and two-loop beta functions, giving a stringent consistency check on the general three-loop gauge beta function; for N=1 SUSY gives a condition on the chiral-field anomalous dimension guaranteeing an exact all-order a-function, verified to fifth order (three-loop anomalous dimension).
loop_order: a-function at 4 loops; N=1 check to 5th order
theory: general gauge-Yukawa-scalar theories; N=1 SUSY gauge theories
symmetry_argument: gradient-flow (Weyl consistency) equation with a positive-definite metric

proved: (per abstract) 4-loop a-function construction and consistency of the general 3-loop gauge beta
assumed: N=1 all-order statement verified only to fifth order

evidence: arXiv abstract (v2 corrected sign errors in Sec. 5)
red_flags: abstract-level record; gamma5 treatment not assessed
notes: The N=1 part is an instance where SUSY relations among beta functions are checked against WCC at high order.
